## What changed

- `crates/hh-env/src/publication.rs` (+703, new) — the
  `hh-publication-withheld/1` record: closed seven-leg vocabulary
  `gate_readout|pins_frozen|spine_vocabulary|refusal_vocabulary|
  study_carried|publication_absent|claims_withheld`; records-in
  leg evaluators over supplied facts only (`evaluate_humans`,
  `evaluate_pins`, `evaluate_spine`, `evaluate_refusals`,
  `evaluate_carried`, `evaluate_publication`, `evaluate_claims` +
  the R5.50 `evaluate_gate` consumed unchanged) — never
  manufacturing an artifact, a URL, a channel act, a correction,
  a date or a claim; `withheld|failed|inconclusive` fold —
  definitive failure dominates undetermined; `assemble()` refuses
  any leg set not `LEGS`-unique-and-complete; `packet_id` minted
  last over the canonical record minus itself; `Disposition`
  re-exported from `confirm` (one closed vocabulary, never a
  second implementation).
- `crates/hh-env/tests/r5_54.rs` (+892, new) — the battery: the
  ten pinned inputs re-verified for real via `check_pins`; the
  §8.3 spine/claim/correction vocabulary read off the landed

  through the real evaluators (pure in-process — the refusals
  fire before anything is admitted); the pinned study report
